name: MagicReply
oneLiner: AI tool that drafts and posts replies to Google Business Profile reviews in a business's own voice, with auto-reply rules and a Chrome extension.
bestFor: Independent restaurants, cafes and small groups that mainly need fast, on-brand replies to Google reviews at a low monthly price.

updates.text: Voice profiles became per location and can be auto-extracted from 10+ replied reviews (March 14, 2026); review request emails with your branding and a direct Google review link per location were added March 10, 2026; Collections and website review widgets March 12, 2026.
Chrome Extension 2.0 (March 15, 2026) fills AI replies into Google's review box, with tone and length controls.

features: AI-drafted replies to Google Business Profile reviews that you can edit or regenerate before posting
Voice profile learned from your past replies (greeting, sign-off, vocabulary), extracted from 10+ replied reviews and set per location
Auto-reply rules by star rating, keywords or sentiment, with delays and approvals (Pro and Business)
Free reply templates on its site, including restaurant and cafe templates for great food and service, food quality complaints and wait times (https://magicreply.ai/templates)
Restaurant page says replies address specific dishes, service speed, ambiance and dining experience (vendor positioning, https://magicreply.ai/use-cases/restaurants)
Chrome extension that inserts replies into Google's review interface, with tone and length controls
Review request emails and a direct Google review link for each location
Role-based team permissions with manager approval before replies go live, and an analytics dashboard for response rates and sentiment trends
Bulk reply generation and website review widgets

pricing.text: Free plan ($0, 1 Google location, a limited total of AI replies and Google posts that does not renew monthly); Pro $19.99/month (1 location, unlimited AI replies, auto-reply, voice profile, analytics); Business $49.99/month (unlimited locations, team collaboration). 7-day trial on paid plans, card required, charged automatically after the trial unless cancelled. Custom enterprise plans for 10+ locations.

notes: Small product from Somnus Labs Inc. (per its terms); no named customers or press coverage found, so customers is empty. Free-plan limits conflict between the pricing page and FAQ (up to 15 AI replies and 5 Google posts in total, not monthly) and the changelog (free plan raised from 3 to 5 AI replies, March 5, 2026), so the review should not state exact free limits. Google-only: no Yelp, TripAdvisor or delivery-app reviews confirmed. 'Dish-aware' replies are the vendor's restaurant positioning; the restaurant templates cover food and service, food quality and wait times (value is not covered); homepage testimonials are self-published and unverified. Pricing, FAQ, changelog, templates and restaurant pages fetched 2026-11. The homepage and FAQ footers name only 'MagicReply'. No G2 listing found, so no rating.
pros: Low price: Pro $19.99 a month; Business $49.99 a month for unlimited locations
Auto-reply rules by star rating, keywords or sentiment, with delays and approvals
Voice profile per location, learned from past replies
Chrome extension fills replies into Google's own review box
Free restaurant reply templates for food quality complaints and wait times

cons.text: Supports Google Business Profile reviews only; Yelp, TripAdvisor, Facebook and delivery apps are not listed
The free plan's AI replies and Google posts are a total allowance that does not renew each month
Pro covers one Google location; more locations need the Business plan
The 7-day trial on paid plans needs a card and charges automatically unless you cancel

plans.trial: 7-day free trial on Pro and Business (card required)
